About
Welcome to the Pennington County's GIS Public Map Service. This interactive web mapping application allows users to search for and view Pennington County GIS data including property parcels and historical aerial photography. Some basic tips and tricks are listed below.
Any of the tools below can be closed using the x in the top right comer.
Legend
Use this to view the Legend of the labels and symbols in the map.
Layer List
Use this to turn individual layers in the map on or off. Click the triangle to the left of the Group layer to expand it and show the additional layers underneath it.
Searching for data
Use the Query tool to search for specific features:
Search by Parcel Number
Search by Taxpayer Name
Search by Physical Address
Advanced Measure
Choose either distance or area and click a location on the map to start drawing a line.
Show labels while drawing – The measurement will be visible as you draw the line on screen.
Toggle measurement labels – Toggle measurement labels on or off.
Stream Mode - Enables you to click once and drag to draw a line.
Use the clear buttons to remove the measurements.
Draw
Use this tool to add additional mark-ups to the map before printing or emailing to other users.
Print
Use this tool to generate a map that can be printed or saved for future reference. Choose the layout, format and advanced options then click the print button. When the map has finished generating click on the appropriate image icon to open it.
Coordinate Conversion
Use this tool to find the coordinate conversion for a specific point on the map. Either enter the coordinates in the box or click the marker icon
and then click on the map to add a point. The results will be displayed in DD (Decimal Degrees), DMS (Degrees – Minutes – Seconds), or USNG (United States National Grid).
